evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with trust and autonomy
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD emphasizes speed and iteration ('thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact', 'moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook') with only a single data-quality mention, so velocity signals dominate.
evidence.domain_risk: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would affect internal product decisions and customer-facing insights but not regulatory or financial reporting, placing this at moderate risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Motivated by ownership of the entire product analytics function at an early stage company
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role is explicitly framed as building the analytics foundation from scratch at an early-stage company with no existing analytics function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain dashboards to track product usage, funnels, retention, activation, user journey paths, and feature adoption
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities are specific and precise about product analytics scope (funnels, retention, activation, event instrumentation), giving a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Analyze user journeys to identify friction, improve activation, and drive growth
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is the product function — usage, funnels, activation, feature adoption — even though sales/marketing/CS also receive analyses.
evidence.autonomy_level: you will build and own the product analytics foundation at Profound. You will define success metrics
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The candidate is expected to define metrics and own the analytics function's direction, not just execute assigned tasks.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Despite the company building an AI product, no AI tool usage or AI-data-enablement work is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Partner with engineers to instrument events, maintain data ingestion pipelines, and uphold high data quality
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is mentioned as an outcome to uphold but with no named testing framework or ownership process — falls short of a formal responsibility framing, and no tool is listed either, so absent is the better fit.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in growth and capability terms with no risk, compliance, or trust language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: you will build and own the product analytics foundation at Profound
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role explicitly builds the analytics foundation from zero at an early-stage, fast-growing startup.
evidence.work_arrangement: This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office
